messages:
omar (oncall): heads-up: I opened a hotpatch PR to address the latency spike we saw on kv-proxy (p99 ~ 350ms). small change: tighten backoff, shrink conn pool, add a defensive circuit-breaker. tests included. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4923 - can someone take a quick review + approval? tagging @jess @lee. rollback PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4924

sre-ci-bot: CI started for infra#4923 (linux/mac/unit). linux passed, mac flaky on test_kv_conn_stress (rerunning).

jess: on it, grabbing coffee then will run through.

lee: I can do a quick pass now. rough glance: need one more log line for when circuit trips.

maria: fyi trying to avoid a full rollback during peak — what's the deploy window?

omar (oncall): planning a 10% canary for 15m after merge, then ramp. deploy window is open now; if anyone prefers to hold we can wait 30m.

lee: left 2 small comments on the PR re: backoff math and logging. nothing blocking.

omar (oncall): addressed both, pushed a fixup. updated PR description with canary plan. force-pushed.

jess: quick security / config check done. no secrets touched. approving once CI is green. :eyes:

sre-ci-bot: mac rerun succeeded. all checks passed.

lee: lgtm. approving.

omar (oncall): merging in 3min unless objections. will watch metrics and be ready to revert. rollback PR is ready to merge if needed.

maria: watching p50/p95/p99. will call if p99 jumps >20%.

deploy-bot: deploy started for infra#4923 -> staging, canary 10%

jess: :thumbsup:

maria: canary looks stable so far (5m). latencies trending down slightly.

omar (oncall): thanks all — merging now and keeping this on my radar for the hour. closing thread after post-checks.

deploy-bot: deploy completed to canary. health checks OK.

maria: post-deploy metrics good. no new errors in Sentry.

omar (oncall): closing thread — great coordination, appreciate the quick reviews.
